description: Susan Culp for State Representative, Practical Leadership. My campaign is focused on providing a voice for rural Vermont communities. I am dedicated to tackling the affordability crisis in our state - from the housing shortage to the steep rise in property taxes. If elected, I plan to do this by focusing on fiscal accountability in the state budget, identifying wasteful spending that doesn't benefit communities.
